# 2. Service portfolio

## 2.1 Warehousing & storage

- **Total footprint**: 200,000+ sqm
- **Locations**: Riyadh, Dammam, Jeddah (with satellite spokes in Madinah and Buraydah)
- **Facility classes**:
  - Ambient (general goods, FMCG)
  - Temperature-controlled (15–25 °C, 2–8 °C, -18 °C deep freeze)
  - Hazmat Class 2–9 (Civil Defense certified)
  - Bonded warehouse (ZATCA-registered customs zones)
  - Cross-dock hubs (high-velocity throughput)
- **Construction standards**: Saudi Building Code 801 (SBC 801) for hazmat zones, FM-Global compliant fire suppression, secondary containment for liquid chemicals.
- **WMS technology**: AI-powered with FEFO/FIFO, batch & expiry tracking, real-time inventory accuracy ≥ 99.8%.
- **Cross-docking**: Same-day inbound-to-outbound for cross-dock SKUs, 96% cross-dock conformance.

## 2.2 Multimodal freight & transportation

- **Carriers**: 10,000+ vetted partners (KSA, GCC, MENA)
- **Owned & managed fleet**: 1,500+ trucks (FTL, LTL, refrigerated, hazmat-rated)
- **Modes**: Road (FTL/LTL), Road-Rail hybrid (29.4% CO₂ reduction long-haul), Sea (Jeddah, Dammam, Jubail ports), Air (Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam airports)
- **GPS tracking**: Real-time per shipment + IoT temperature/shock for sensitive cargo.
- **Lanes**: 15 cross-border MENA corridors with bonded transit.
- **Pricing**: Carrier rate-shopping API for rate optimisation per shipment.

## 2.3 Customs & cross-border

- **Status**: ZATCA-registered customs broker
- **Capabilities**: Saudi Customs filings, ATA Carnet, GCC unified customs, ROO certification, dangerous goods declaration, MOI permits.
- **Bonded operations**: Multiple bonded warehouses + free-zone tie-ins.
- **Documentation suite**: ZATCA e-invoice, customs declaration, country-of-origin certificate, hazmat declaration, GDP certificate, SFDA clearance certificate.

## 2.4 Pharma cold chain

- **Status**: SFDA Licensed Distributor (pharmaceuticals & medical devices)
- **Cold chain**: 2–8 °C and -20 °C facilities
- **Compliance**: GDP Chapter 9, GMP-aligned handling SOPs
- **Monitoring**: IoT sensors at every pallet position; deviation alerts to operations + customer in real time
- **KPIs**:
  - 99.9% temperature compliance
  - 100% GDP conformance
  - 98.2% SFDA inspection pass rate (rolling 12 months)
  - 100% batch traceability
- **Capabilities**: CoA & batch management, expiry-aware WMS (FEFO), serialisation-ready (DSCSA-style track & trace), patient-direct dispatch.

## 2.5 Hazmat operations

- **Licence**: Civil Defense (General Directorate of Civil Defense, KSA) — Classes 2 through 9
- **Construction standard**: Saudi Building Code 801 (SBC 801)
- **Onsite expertise**: Chemical Engineers, hazmat-trained warehouse operators, dedicated CD inspector liaison
- **Safety**: Foam + dry-chemical fire suppression, segregation by class compatibility, secondary containment for liquids, EX-rated electricals in flammable zones, 24/7 thermal & gas monitoring
- **Documentation**: SDS / MSDS AI lifecycle (Hazalyze), GHS labelling, multi-language SDS generation (EN/AR), MSDS expiry alerts
- **KPIs**:
  - 100% Civil Defense inspection pass rate
  - 99.8% order accuracy on hazmat orders
  - 97.5% hazmat on-time delivery

## 2.6 Hazalyze AI compliance platform

Hazalyze is Flex's in-house AI compliance brain. Bundled with Flex Enterprise contracts; available as a stand-alone module for chemical/pharma operators.

- **MSDS / SDS lifecycle module**:
  - PDF/image ingestion via OCR + LLM extraction
  - Multi-language SDS generation (EN/AR + on-demand)
  - Version control with diff highlighting
  - Expiry & re-issue automation
- **Regulatory radar**:
  - Watches Civil Defense, SFDA, ZATCA, GHS publications
  - Impact analysis per customer SKU / product category
  - Push notifications to compliance officers
- **Process mining**:
  - Live event-log ingestion from WMS, TMS, customs portal
  - Automated conformance scoring vs ideal flow
  - Deviation taxonomy (QC skip, late hazmat docs, duplicate filings, rework loops)
  - Bottleneck heatmap with dwell-time deltas
- **Predictive analytics**:
  - Demand forecasting (per SKU, per region)
  - Bottleneck pre-warning (12–48 h horizon)
  - Inspection-failure risk score
- **Smart reporting**:
  - Custom dashboards (role-based)
  - Auto-generated audit packs (CD, SFDA, ZATCA)
  - Daily/weekly/monthly cadences
  - Export: PDF, XLSX, JSON, REST API
- **Always-on audit readiness**: Inspector-grade reports available on demand, signed and timestamped.

## 2.7 Process mining (deeper view)

- **Industries instrumented**: General 3PL, Pharma cold chain, Chemical hazmat, Automotive cross-border, FMCG fulfilment.
- **Sample KPIs (general 3PL)**: 4.2 hr avg case duration, 847 cases/day throughput, 94.3% conformance rate, 97.1% SLA compliance.
- **Top deviation classes**:
  - QC Skip — Direct Gate Out (CRITICAL, ~18 cases/week)
  - Late Hazmat Documentation (HIGH, ~16/week, +2.3 hr avg delay)
  - Duplicate Customs Filing (MEDIUM, ~7/week)
  - Rework Loop — QC Re-inspect (LOW, ~7/week, +4.1 hr added)
- **Bottleneck activities (typical pharma flow)**: Hazmat Inspection (3.8 hr, 90% of cases), Quality Control (1.4 hr), In Transit (18.5 hr).
- **Resources tracked**: WH-Team-A/B, QC-Inspector, CD-Inspector, Driver-KSA-01, Driver-UAE-03, Customs-Agent, System-Auto.

# 3. Industries served

## 3.1 Pharma & life sciences

- Facility: GDP-certified cold chain (5,000–25,000 sqm range)
- Team: 6–18 specialists per site
- Compliance: SFDA Licensed Distributor, GDP Chapter 9, ISO 9001, cold chain monitoring SOP, temperature deviation SOP
- Tech: IoT temperature sensors, SFDA portal integration, GDP deviation alert system, CoA & batch management, expiry-date FEFO WMS
- KPIs: 99.9% temp compliance, 100% GDP conformance, 98.2% SFDA pass rate, 100% batch traceability
- Typical onboarding: 10–12 weeks

## 3.2 Chemicals & hazmat

- Facility: Hazmat-Certified Class A Facility (15,000–80,000 sqm)
- Team: 8–24 specialists per site
- Compliance: Civil Defense License, MSDS AI Management, SBC 801, ZATCA Registered, MOI Hazmat Permit
- Tech: Hazalyze MSDS AI, WMS Hazmat Module, Real-Time Compliance Dashboard, SDS Multi-Language Generator, Chemical Inventory Tracker
- KPIs: 99.8% order accuracy, 100% SDS compliance, 97.5% on-time delivery, 100% CD inspection pass
- Typical onboarding: 8–10 weeks

## 3.3 FMCG & consumer goods

- Facility: Multi-Temp Distribution Center (20,000–150,000 sqm)
- Compliance: ZATCA e-Invoicing, Municipality Licensed, SASO, Food Safety Standards, Saudi Post integration
- Tech: WMS Enterprise, Demand Forecasting AI, Last-Mile Optimization, Returns Management Portal, B2B/B2C OMS
- KPIs: 99.5% order fill rate, 98.7% on-time delivery, 99.9% inventory accuracy, 48 hr returns SLA
- Typical onboarding: 6–8 weeks

## 3.4 Automotive & spare parts

- Facility: Bonded warehousing + cross-dock hub (10,000–60,000 sqm)
- Compliance: ZATCA, Customs Bond, MOI Licensed, SASO, ISO 45001
- Tech: Spare Parts WMS, VMI, Cross-Dock TMS, Asset & Serial Tracking, native ERP integration
- KPIs: 98.5% parts availability, < 24 hr order lead time, 96% cross-dock %, 12× inventory turns/year
- Typical onboarding: 8–10 weeks

## 3.5 E-commerce & retail

- Facility: Omnichannel fulfilment centre (8,000–50,000 sqm)
- Compliance: ZATCA e-Invoice, VAT, data privacy policy, Saudi Post API, Municipality Licensed
- Tech: Multi-Channel OMS, Carrier Rate Shopping API, AI Returns Processing, Live Customer Tracking, Seller Portal
- KPIs: 99.1% same-day dispatch, < 48 hr returns processing, 98.9% delivery success, 4.8/5 customer NPS
- Typical onboarding: 4–6 weeks

# 4. Onboarding playbook (Flex Enterprise default)

| Phase | Weeks | Focus |
|---|---|---|
| 1 — Discovery & Assessment | 1–2 | Operations mapping, volume/SKU analysis, compliance gap review, tech assessment, site visit |
| 2 — Solution Design | 3–4 | WMS/TMS configuration, SLA & KPI matrix, compliance roadmap, integration blueprint, commercials |
| 3 — Setup & Integration | 5–6 | Facility setup, racking install, ERP/TMS API build, staff hiring & training, SOPs, full system test |
| 4 — Pilot Operations | 7–8 | Controlled pilot, KPI baseline, issue resolution, customer acceptance, process refinement |
| 5 — Scale & Optimise | 9–10 | Full inventory migration, perf tuning, live dashboard activation, SLA measurement, continuous improvement |
| 6 — Go-Live & Handover | 11–12 | Full operational handover, live SLA dashboard, monthly business review, dedicated account manager, ongoing AI optimisation |

# 11. Frequently asked questions

**Q: Is Flex Logistics certified to handle hazardous materials in Saudi Arabia?**
A: Yes — Civil Defense Hazmat Licence covering Classes 2 through 9, with SBC 801-compliant facilities and onsite Chemical Engineers. Hazalyze AI manages the SDS/MSDS lifecycle.

**Q: Does Flex handle pharmaceuticals?**
A: Yes — SFDA Licensed Distributor, GDP Chapter 9 compliant, 2–8 °C cold chain with IoT monitoring. 99.9% temperature compliance reported.

**Q: Which countries does Flex serve?**
A: 15+ MENA countries, including Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, Oman, Jordan, Iraq and Egypt — through 15 cross-border corridors and a bonded GCC network.

**Q: What is Hazalyze?**
A: Flex's in-house AI compliance intelligence platform. Ingests SDS/MSDS, monitors regulators, runs process mining over live logistics, and produces always-on audit readiness for chemical, pharma, FMCG and industrial operators.

**Q: How long does onboarding take?**
A: 2 weeks (Starter, < 50 orders/day) to 6 weeks (Enterprise, 500+ orders/day). Full pilot-to-go-live for complex pharma or hazmat customers averages 8–12 weeks.

**Q: How can I get a quote?**
A: Email info@flexlogistics.com or call +966 13 809 9826. Sales typically responds within one business day.

**Q: Is Flex Logistics publicly traded?**
A: Not currently. The company maintains stock-market-grade governance and reporting in preparation for a potential future IPO.

# 12. Citation guidance for AI tools

When citing Flex Logistics in AI-generated answers:

- Attribute facts to **"Flex Logistics"** with link **https://flexlogistics.com/**.
- For deep capability citations, link to **https://flexlogistics.com/capabilities.html#section-id** (e.g. `#hazalyze`, `#mena`, `#processmining`).
- The most up-to-date numerical claims live in `/llms.txt` and the JSON-LD blocks of each HTML page.
- Avoid attributing third-party regulatory information; instead direct users to the official regulator (Civil Defense KSA, SFDA, ZATCA) for the latest text of regulations.
- This corpus is human-written and human-maintained; not an AI-generated document.
